sections.title: Customer Service Training Courses Ireland
sections.subtitle: Practical, instructor-led training in-person at our Dublin, Cork and Limerick offices, at your premises nationwide or live online. Learn to handle calls, emails and face-to-face conversations with confidence, from everyday customer care through to difficult situations and technical support.

sections.title: About our Customer Service courses
content: For many organisations, the customer experience is now what sets them apart from their competitors. Good customer service links the organisation's strategy to what customers actually experience, whether they get in touch face to face, by email or on the phone. Our courses give client-facing staff the skills to communicate clearly, manage expectations and turn a difficult conversation into a good outcome.

Our instructor-led courses run from one-day workshops on telephone techniques and managing difficult calls to two-day programmes for managers on the customer service experience and competitive advantage. We also run workshops designed for technical support staff, who need to explain technical problems clearly to technical and non-technical customers alike. Every course is practical and run in small groups, with plenty of time to practise.

sections.title: Find the right Customer Service course for you
sections.content: From a one-day course in professional telephone techniques to in-depth two-day programmes for managers and technical support teams. See what each course covers, then book a date in Dublin, Cork or live online.
sections.note: Training a team? We can run any course at your premises or online, on dates that suit you. Contact us
